source: CC-CEDICT (cedict.json via npm cedict-json package, equivalent to cedict_ts.u8)
ranking_source: HSK 3.0 word lists levels 1-9 (npm @leonsilicon/hsk3.0), then remaining CEDICT compounds in dictionary order
filter: 2-4 hanzi compound words for HSK stages; from wave 3 onward ONLY 2-hanzi compound words per user request ('chỉ dịch từ ghép từ 2 chữ')

stages.stage: remaining CEDICT compounds (post-HSK), 2-4 hanzi mixed, waves 1-2
stages.ranking: CEDICT dictionary order (not frequency-ranked) — rare/classical/technical/proper-noun entries, includes 2/3/4-hanzi words

scope_change: User requested (mid-run) to stop translating 3-4 hanzi words and continue with 2-hanzi compounds only. Waves 1-2 above (mixed length, already in flight) were kept since already processed. From wave 3 onward, batches are built from a 2-hanzi-only filtered list.
resume_instructions: 2-hanzi-only remaining word list to be built at scratchpad cedict_work/remaining_all.json filtered to len(word)==2, minus words already in cedict.vi.txt, pre-split into 500-word batches at scratchpad cedict_work/batches_2char/b_NNN.json. To resume: pick next unprocessed b_NNN.json, translate via agent into out_NNN.tsv, verify line count, append to cedict.vi.txt, update this file.
